verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows user-defined rules that fire actions automatically when events occur. The API is request-and-poll (poll `GET /v1/tasks/{id}`), with no documented event triggers or callbacks. Workflows are node-graph pipelines published as endpoints you invoke, Model Routers are routing preferences rather than event rules, and Runway Ads' automated ad cycle is a built-in product loop, not a rule engine the user configures.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
